title: Reducing Hallucinations in LLMs via Factuality-Aware Preference Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The focus was on general factuality and hallucination reduction.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
